ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is a six-membered aromatic ring skeleton with alternating double bonds; at the lower-left/lower-right position there is an exocyclic imine nitrogen labeled NH; the adjacent position on the right side of the left ring is connected by a single bond to the saturated six-membered ring on the right side. The lower-right carbon of the right six-membered ring has an exocyclic positively charged NH2+, and a double bond is drawn. Multiple curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Then reason: According to the specified method, read only the atom-bond skeleton. Starting from the left imine carbon, write the exocyclic imine as N=C1; traverse along the left benzene-like ring according to alternating double bonds as C=CC=CC1; attach the right cyclohexane skeleton at the adjacent ring carbon, written as C1CCCCC1; finally write the exocyclic double bond between this cyclohexane carbon and the positively charged amino nitrogen as =[NH2+]. Combining gives N=C1C=CC=CC1C1CCCCC1=[NH2+].

method.method_draft: First read only the atom-bond skeleton from the image and discard all curved arrows. Choose the left imine carbon as the start: write the exocyclic imine as N=C1, then traverse the left benzene-like ring with alternating double bonds as C=CC=CC1. At the adjacent ring carbon, follow the single bond into the right cyclohexane ring and encode it as C1CCCCC1. Finally add the exocyclic double bond from that cyclohexane carbon to the positively charged amino nitrogen as =[NH2+]. Combine the pieces to obtain N=C1C=CC=CC1C1CCCCC1=[NH2+].
method.CoT_raw:

再推理：按指定方法只读取原子-键骨架。从左侧 imine 碳开始，外接亚胺写作 N=C1；沿左侧苯样环按交替双键遍历为 C=CC=CC1；在相邻环碳处接入右侧环己烷骨架，写作 C1CCCCC1；最后把该环己烷碳与带正电氨基氮的外接双键写为 =[NH2+]。合并得到 N=C1C=CC=CC1C1CCCCC1=[NH2+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the skeletal drawing: a left six-membered carbocycle drawn in a Kekulé benzene pattern has an exocyclic imine N= at the lower-right ring carbon and an adjacent bond from the upper-right ring carbon to a right cyclohexane ring. planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored; no other textual chemical data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard line-angle conventions where unlabeled vertices are carbons and implied hydrogens fill valence. Convert the two six-membered rings and the two exocyclic imine/iminium groups into SMILES ring-closure notation; use bracketed [NH2+] for the positively charged iminium nitrogen. A valid Kekulé SMILES is N=C1C=CC=CC1C1CCCCC1=[NH2+].
